notes.title: Layers of Fear: the Series Crowning Work Is Coming out Next Month
notes.content:
Bloober Team's venture into horror began with the Layers series; the upcoming Layers of Fear will be the series' most important work and is scheduled to launch in June 2023. Developed in collaboration with Anshar Studios, it promises to deliver fresh gameplay, chapters, and a visually stunning experience. Here's a brief look at what awaits our dear players.

Game Content

The series’ upcoming magnum opus is the definitive way to experience the critically acclaimed franchise as it features Layers of Fear and Layers of Fear 2, as well as all DLCs (including the new ‘The Final Note’ DLC that will give you a new perspective on the Layers of Fear storyline) and the never-before-told story of The Writer, which will tie everything together. Built on Unreal Engine 5, Layers of Fear supports Ray Tracing, HDR, and 4K resolution to make the stunning visuals, and your nightmarish experience, as immersive and realistic as possible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9911718/7f5ba1257926ee64f62f35db18789fcffb8fffa1.png

Gameplay Preview

Check out our latest 11-minute gameplay video and get ready to immerse yourself in the horrors that await new players and long-time fans of the Layers of Fear series. Witness the unveiling of the new mechanic, the lantern, and take a sneak peek at the gameplay in a new setting — inside a lighthouse.

[previewyoutube=hVioJM_lKwU;full][/previewyoutube]

Next-Generation Graphics

In addition to introducing brand new chapters and gameplay elements, Layers of Fear also demonstrates the impressive potential of Unreal Engine 5 - it's one of the very first games to date that were built with the newest technology. Take a look at the game's stunning graphics in a showcase video here.

[previewyoutube=iMkN8whZQmQ;full][/previewyoutube]

There's much more to learn about the game, go check out the Layers of Fear's Steam card for more information. Keep a close eye there as our developers host streams about the game from time to time.

Don't forget to share your comments and insights in the comment section of the news. Thanks for following!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1946700/Layers_of_Fear/

notes.title: Revisit the Madness in Layers of Fear: Inheritance on August 2, 2016
notes.content:
We’re proud to present Layers of Fear: Inheritance, a unique piece of DLC which expands the plot from Layers of Fear and tells the story of the painter’s daughter coming back to her childhood home to face her past. Can she forgive her father, or will she resent all that has happened? Relive her experiences and witness the full scope of the tragedy that has swallowed up the family.

Game features:
- A completely new narrative experience that expands the story of Layers of Fear
- Explore the painter’s house from his daughter’s perspective
- Multiple endings based on how you play the game
- A return to the terrifying and psychedelic experience players loved from the base game
 
The DLC will also include an update for the base game with tons of fixes for the base game (judder, I'm looking at you).  The price of the DLC will be set at $4.99

[EDIT] 
As there were some voices of concern about the update fixes - yes the base game will be updated regardless of whether you bought the DLC or not. 

See you again in the manor on August 2nd!

notes.title: The Masterpiece patch - full game release
notes.content:
Hey Guys!

You have been patiently waiting for this day to come – Layers of Fear is out now on PC/Mac/Linux, Xbox One and PlayStation 4!

Working with you guys during the Early Access period has been an honour for us. Without your comments, constructive criticism, ideas and general feedback we wouldn’t be able to create a product that Layers of Fear has grown into. We would like to thank you for your time, dedication and for supporting us in our vision. You’re awesome!

You would probably want to know what has change during the transition from The Goya Patch to the final release, well here are the patch notes:

-	The number of rooms have increased from about 70 to more than a     hundred
-	A lot of the rooms from the Early Access has been redesigned
-	The final chapters of the game have been implemented (duh!)
-	New findable objects have been added, other were redesigned
-	Additional VO, including female voices
-	New music tracks added
-	Achievements and steam cards added
-	Redesigned death animations and added new respawn rooms
-	A lot of fixes to mini games, door opening mechanics,
-	Performance optimization 

Remember! If you feel that you have beaten the game – you’re wrong! 
Go and uncover all of the layers of fear we have prepared for you!

Also, check out the launch trailer!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ihKltvEUdNg

notes.title: Goya Patch – November 30th 2015
notes.content:
Hey guys! Sorry for the late update! Here is the log for today's patch:

-	We have added new rooms and remodelled some of the old ones, nearing up to almost 20 completely new room experiences you can encounter. Those rooms should now work as a breather and slow down the pacing of the game a bit. 
[edit] to clarify, all of the levels added are in the part of the game that has been previously available to you. The rest of the story, containing the ending, will be added in the official release of the game.

-	New findable objects have been added, as well as some of the older ones have been redesigned.

-	German and French languages have been added (subtitles, UI). They are the work of our fans, who supported us in the development process. Big up for them!  

-	Small localization corrections.

-	Game Menu fixes – minor aesthetic and graphical adjustments; Navigation problems while using a game pad have now been fixed.

-	We have changed the mouse cursor in-game – it should also now disappear correctly while looking at findable objects.

-	Fixed the issue when inverting axis’ made opening object illogical (you had to push to actually pull, etc.)

-       You can now disable gamepad acceleration.

notes.title: Halloween patch – October 28th 2015
notes.content:
- A new room connected to Halloween has been added. You can enter it from the basement in the first level of the game (the complete house). It will be an exclusive content that will last only for a month. The first three people who will find all of the unique effects connected with the key words will find their way into the game, as their own portraits that will be added to Layers of Fear. 

[!] It is advised to complete the game before going to the event’s room.

- New languages have been added:
•	Polish
•	Italian

- Chapter Select added – now you can replay each previously finished chapter without losing progress from your game.

- New graphical options have been added – texture quality, shadows quality, mirror reflections, chromatic abberation.

- Fixed some issues with key / button binding.

- The right mouse buton has now been restored as the primary key to leave close-up screens (looking at objects, reading news clippings, etc.)

- You can now skip the intro scene by holding either the space bar key (PC), or the X button on Xbox game pads.

- A new checkpoint has been added after starting a new game.

- When starting up the game you should no longer encounter the ‘application is not responding’ message.

- Minor bug fixes and tweaks to the levels.

notes.title: van Eyck Patch - 30-09-2015
notes.content:
Hey guys! Last week update is now live! ;)

Sorry for the delay, here are the patch notes:

[New OS support]

This moment has been awaited by many! You will now be able to play on:

Steam OS
Mac OS X

Be warned! The game is not yet fully optimized for these systems! You will need at least:

Mac:
Mac Pro (Mid 2012):
3.2GHz Quad-Core Intel Xeon, ATI Radeon HD 5770 with 1GB GDDR5 memory, 6GB RAM.

Steam OS:
Intel Core i5 3470, NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 Ti 2GB

[!] The game has not been tested on other Linux distributions and it is highly possible it won’t work for now! 

[Gamepad support]

There were a few issues with playing on gamepads, but now everything should work fine. Supported controllers are as follows:

- Windows 7 – Xbox 360 Pad, Xbox One Pad, PS4 Pad
- Windows 8 – Xbox 360 Pad, Xbox One Pad, PS4 Pad
- Windows 10 – Xbox 360 Pad, Xbox One Pad, PS4 Pad
- Mac OS – Xbox 360 Pad, PS4 Pad
- Steam OS – Xbox 360 Pad, PS4 Pad

[!] Known issue – on Mac and Steam OS there is still a bug - when you unplug the gamepad while the game is still running, and plug it in again, it won’t work as intended. Please refrain from unplugging the gamepad during your playthroughs for now. 

[Saves]

We have added three user profiles, each with their own save game slot.
We have added the support of Steam Cloud.

[Other]

Minor visual GUI changes
Minor level fixes

To avoid further questions regarding content updates:
Yes, we are constantly working on them, but we prefer to make a bigger batch, than add a level with each update (it wouldn’t validate another playthrough in our opinion). Wait patiently and you will be rewarded! 

Cheers!

notes.title: 04-09-2015 Patch
notes.content:
Hi everyone. Thank you for your patience. The first patch is live!

[Graphics]
- Under Settings -> Graphics you will find the information on which GPU the game is currently running
- The default graphical settings are now set to Medium
- You can enable / disable fullscreen mode (windowed mode) 
- You can enable / disable VSync 
- Gamma settings have been tailored - you now can see the gamma changes apply in real time on the screen (in-game)

[Controls]
- Mouse sensitivity controls have been added
- You can enable / disable the invert X and Y axis (both on the mouse and gamepad)
- You can now remap your key bindings, both on the keyboard and the gamepad
- If you use the gamepad, the mouse will automaticaly disable

[Gameplay]
- You can enable / disable crosshair in the game.
- You can enable / disable the "head bobbing" effect
- We have added a Field of View slider 

[Other]
- The fps counter will no longer pop up after hitting F12
- Continue has been moved to the top of the main menu
- If you try to open the door to a room that's still loading you will receive a proper indication icon.
- We have disabled the camera rotation movements on the use of Q,E,Z,X keys 
- We have added Google Analytics support to the game that will give us more insight into how you play Layers of Fear.

[Design]
- numerous bug fixes
- lighting adjustments
- visual improvements & corrections
